summary: KPI with a label, a value formatted with Intl, and an optional change.
whenNotToUse: Time series: use a chart (not included) or a table.

props.name: value
props.description: Numbers are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat in the current locale.

props.name: trend
props.description: Change; the direction is announced in (localized) words.

accessibility: The trend direction is text, not just an arrow or color.
sentiment separates direction from judgment (e.g. a positive drop in churn).
responsive: Value with tabular figures; text wraps in narrow containers.
commonMistakes: Formatting numbers manually and ignoring the locale.

examples.name: SizesAndStates
examples.title: Sizes, long labels, and missing data
examples.description: sm, md, and lg variants; a downward but positive trend, units of measure, and a missing value.

examples.name: LocaleComparison
examples.title: Italian and English formatting
examples.description: The same value formatted with LocaleProvider it-IT and en-US, including compact notation.

examples.name: LiveValue
examples.title: Controlled value
examples.description: The value lives in the example's state; the trend direction and text update with the buttons.
